This is not the first data centre project proposed by the Telangana government. Amazon Web Services (AWS) had earlier announced its data centre investment, followed by projects from TCS HyperVault and CtrlS. Speaking at the ‘Praja Palana Dinotsavam’ celebration organised by the state government on Thursday, September 17, CM Revanth said the Future City would feature specialised zones such as the Young India Skills University, a Life Sciences Hub, an EV Park, a Health City and an Education City. Among CM Revanth’s pitches, an AI city is a major part of his plans for the Future City, an area encompassing Muccharla, Meerkhanpet and Kandukur regions in Ranga Reddy district of Telangana. Amid the data centre push, AWS had earlier announced a Rs 60,000-crore investment in a data centre in Telangana under a framework agreement signed at the Telangana Rising Global Summit in December 2025.
